name: Wildfire - Ticket to Rock
source:
Hanako is a teenage girl who prefers to spend her time playing video games with her friends. She’s kind but a little absent-minded and this tends to get her into trouble every now and then. Overall, her life is fine, but she’s feeling like there’s something missing.

A mistake and a chance encounter force her out of her comfort zone as she tries to make amends. In the end she finds herself being the bass player in a rock band along with four other girls. Together they have a common goal, to perform in a music festival in their city. The Wildfire Festival.

[From[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ticket-to-rock/wildfire-ticket-to-rock/description] Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
花子是个十几岁的女孩，最喜欢和朋友一起打游戏。她心地善良，却有些迷糊，时不时因此惹上麻烦。总体而言，她的生活过得不错，只是总觉得少了些什么。

一个错误与一次偶遇，让她为弥补过失而不得不走出舒适区。最终，她与另外四名女孩组成摇滚乐队，成为其中的贝斯手。她们有一个共同目标，就是登上本市举办的“野火音乐节”演出。

[摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ticket-to-rock/wildfire-ticket-to-rock/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
